title: Pain under the right ribs
personality: Irritable because of the pain, answers in detail
chief_complaint: Doctor, since last night I have strong pain under the right ribs.
history_present_illness: Yesterday evening after a family dinner with fatty fried food a strong pain started under the right ribs. It has not stopped for more than 12 hours, it goes to the right shoulder blade. I vomited twice with bile, it did not help. In the morning the temperature was 38.1. Before, after fatty food, I had short attacks of pain in the same place that went away in an hour.

symptoms.name: right upper abdominal pain
symptoms.details: constant for more than 12 hours, 8 out of 10, started after fatty food

symptoms.name: previous attacks
symptoms.details: short attacks after fatty food during the last year

medications: Nothing regularly. Took No-Spa at night, it did not help.
social_history: Does not smoke, alcohol rarely. Likes fatty and fried food.

test_results.Abdominal palpation: Tenderness and guarding in the right upper quadrant, positive Murphy, Ortner and Mussi-Georgievsky (phrenicus) signs. No peritoneal signs elsewhere.
test_results.Blood biochemistry: Total bilirubin 19 µmol/L, ALT 42 U/L, AST 38 U/L, alkaline phosphatase 130 U/L, amylase 64 U/L.
test_results.Abdominal ultrasound: Gallbladder distended, wall thickened to 5 mm with double contour, multiple stones up to 15 mm, one impacted in the neck. Positive sonographic Murphy sign. Common bile duct 5 mm.

diagnosis.name: Calculus of gallbladder with acute cholecystitis
